Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Gallant Smurf
programme.desc: Queen Felicity will not let her son, Prince Godfrey, marry his sweetheart Pricilla. What she wants as a daughter-in-law is a girl who shows her something she's never seen before. When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: Master Scruple
programme.desc: Farmer Smurf is the reluctant master of a genie named Gourdy, whose enthusiasm for service is somewhat excessive. After yet another incident due to Gourdy's overzealousness, Farmer Smurf says something he shouldn't and Gourdy disappears. And guess who finds him? Well, it's Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel. And who should steal Gourdy from Scruple, if not Gargamel himself?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The rain forest of South America is not a place where Vanity Smurf would like to spend his life. And then he starts dancing madly when he gets jungle fever. His dance will have strange results.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are on a paradise Pacific Island. Well, not exactly paradise, since there is a very active volcano, on which a very active Hefty Smurf risks his life as well as Smurfette's!

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every time Lazy falls asleep, he is caught in the same recurrent nightmare: he is in the power of Morphio, an evil sorcerer who wants to capture as many sleeping souls as possible. One after another, all the Smurfs are going to fall in Morphio's clutches. All of them? Well, maybe not, if Papa Smurf can help it. And Papa Smurf goes to the Sandman for help...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Spring has the Smurfs all competing for Smurfette's affection and Gargamel decides to put a spell on her to help him capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf intervenes and with the help of the foolish Azrael he foils the wizard's plans.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh, the sad plight of Hefty Smurf! He used to be the strongest and the best trained of all the Smurfs. But since Wild Smurf arrived in the Village, nobody pays attention to Hefty anymore. What can Papa Smurf do?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs try to avoid contact with humans. But this time, Sassette is happy to be friends with a little witch called Melina, whose spells often end up in disaster. And anyway, are witches really human? At any rate, wizards such as Gargamel are.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs would make delicious meals for the evil wizard Gargamel if it weren't for two things: they're difficult to catch and they're so tiny. Now, suppose there were a formula to change these bite-size snacks into big, juicy square blue meals... Gargamel has an idea...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy's wish of becoming an Astrosmurf comes true when Papa Smurf puts him to sleep, magically transforming the landscape and the Smurfs into a space fantasy. Gargamel keeps a close watch on their antics through his crystal ball, but he too falls victim to Papa Smurf's magic and is sent into a thunderstorm.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Where have all the squirrels gone ? Wild Smurf is a little worried. He’d be more worried still if he knew about the ugly witch Hogatha’s dreadful plan for making herself some hair tonic.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Littlest Witch
programme.desc: On an errand to Witch Haven for Papa Smurf, the little blue creatures meet a tiny witch and teach her how to be good while at the same time cause another witch to lose her wicked powers for one year after she falls into the river.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurflings free the Smurfs from the clutches of Gargamel just in time to get Baby to its first word ceremony. Baby utters the word « Gargamel ». Papa Smurf says that this word indicates that Baby will one day become the Great Chief, as he is aware of the dangers in life.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel casts a spell on Papa's new bed so anyone who sleeps in it is transported to the location of his dream. The drowsy Smurfs' fantasies lead them to a private ship, a castle and finally to Gargamel's. They escape when Clumsy falls asleep and dreams of home.

programme.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
programme.desc: Sure, a village of mushroom-shaped houses is nice and jolly... But not very modern, in Architect Smurf's view. What the Smurfs need is smurfdominium, a new, daring concept that will change the art of living forever...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel the evil wizard is in trouble again. If he can't find an enormous amount of gold by sundown, all his possessions will be taken away from him. But the Smurfs are going to help their arch-enemy... Up to a point.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: If there is one thing that the evil sorceress Chlorhydris cannot abide, it is other people's happiness. The spectacle of the Smurfs' gentle and song-filled life gets Chlorhydsis' hackles up. She must destroy that tinkling laughter, smother those happy repartees... She plants the root of evil in the forest and soon, no Smurf is on speaking terms with another. Baby Smurf is the only one untouched...

programme.title: The Gargoyle Of Quarrel Castle
programme.desc: In Quarrel Castle, you almost never hear a kind word. Both Selwyn the Warlock and Tallulah, his witch-mate, spend their time quarrelling. Tharp, their pet gargoyle, takes refuge in the Village of Smurfs. But something terrible is going to happen....

programme.title: Brainy Smurf, Friend To All Animals
programme.desc: Brainy dons his safari hat and roams the forest to do good deeds for animals. He mostly gives advice to the creatures but balks when he can really save the life of a wildcat being hunted by Gargamel. Nat gives Brainy the courage to free the cat from Gargamel's trap.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork Smurf is feeling so lonely that, out of compassion, Handy Smurf builds a female companion for him. The trouble is, Clockwork Smurfette does not know she's supposed to have eyes only for her mechanical counterpart, or that she should avoid Gargamel....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Scruple, helper to the evil Gargamel, finds the Great Book of Spells in his master's cellar, he asks for the power to be the world's most powerful wizard. This means trouble for the poor little Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Snappy's Way
programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Snappy Smurf sets him free and as a reward, gets to make all other Smurfs obey his every whim. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: Mud-Wrestling Smurfs
programme.desc: The Wartmongers are draining Smurf River to make mud for their wrestling matches. Clumsy, who has been feeling like a loser at sports, becomes a hero when he must wrestle the Mad Maher as a distraction, enabling Papa and Hefty to break into the factory and destroy the mud making machine.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being kind to animals brings unforeseen results for the Smurfs when they decide to bring a baby dinosaur back home... in its own era! This is the start of a series that spans space and time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In trying to avoid doing his chores, Lazy Smurf finds an old abandoned well with an interesting peculiarity: anything that goes down in the bucket comes back up in its original brand-new condition. But is it good?

The Vikings take Peewit to be their mythical Great Warrior, the one who is going to vanquish the Storm King. Can the Smurfs help Peewit out of his quandary?

programme.desc: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar’s insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman’s daughter, the second one married the merchant’s daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren’t they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it’s not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.desc: Fans at the iTunes Festival: London 2011 were blown away with the performance of English singer-songwriter Adele; this concert was recorded live on stage at The Roundhouse in London.

programme.title: Oasis: Live at Wembley Arena 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film gives all fans a spectacular live experience from start to finish.

programme.title: The Lumineers: Live At Musilac 2017
programme.desc: The Lumineers bring energetic American folk-rock to the picturesque Musilac Festival. One will not be able to resist clapping along and stomping their feet to the band's raw sound and enchanting music.

programme.title: Paul Simon: Live in New York City
programme.desc: Paul Simon performs some of his most beloved and classic songs, as well as selections from his critically acclaimed release, "So Beautiful or So What," in a 2011 concert.

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz -- Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: Lenny Kravitz on Sept. 26, 2014, at the iTunes Festival, giving his audience a great concert at the Roundhouse of London.

programme.title: John Legend - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: In college, John Legend participated in a jazz group called Counterparts and at the time was introduced to singer Lauryn Hill, playing piano on the track 'Everything Is Everything' from the singer's first solo album.

programme.title: Celine Dion - Taking Chances World Tour
programme.desc: Part of the world tour of Celine Dion, which was seen by more than 3 million people and covered 5 continents, 25 countries and 92 cities - the first tour in nine years that was an absolute success.

programme.title: Adele: iTunes Festival: Live in London
programme.desc: Fans at the iTunes Festival: London 2011 were blown away with the performance of English singer-songwriter Adele; this concert was recorded live on stage at The Roundhouse in London.

programme.title: Elton John: Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Filmed at the Roundhouse in London, this concert film gives fans a live experience from start to finish; Elton John performs his hits: "Tiny Dancer," "Rocket Man," "Your Song," and many more.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: a-ha: True North
programme.desc: 90km above the Arctic Circle, Norway's very own a-ha recorded their first collection of music since 2015's Cast in Steel. "True North is a letter from a-ha, from the Arctic Circle, a poem from the far north of Norway," says Magne Furuholmen. Accompanied by a film, the conceptual collection combines the band's visions and the talent of Norwegian orchestra, Arctic Philharmonic.

programme.title: AJ Rafael: Take Me Back Tour From Gramercy Theatre
programme.desc: Experience AJ Rafael’s heartfelt “Take Me Back Tour” live from New York City’s Gramercy Theatre. Blending nostalgia and artistry, AJ performs fan favorites and new tracks including “Take Me Back,” “Showstopper,” and “I Just Want You.” Through soulful storytelling, intimate moments, and emotional performances, AJ reflects on his journey from the early Myspace and YouTube days to becoming one of the most beloved independent singer-songwriters of his generation.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Morgan Lander, frontwoman of Canadian heavy metal band Kittie, joins Joel Madden to discuss breaking into the metal scene as teenage girls, reclaiming power in a male-dominated industry, and redefining success on their own terms. Lander reflects on burnout, body autonomy, and growing up in the spotlight before returning stronger than ever.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Warren Zeiders to discuss his unexpected rise from aspiring lacrosse player to country star. Warren reflects on viral success, hit songs like “Pretty Little Poison,” the pressure of following a breakout year, separating self-worth from streaming numbers, and why his new album No Brakes is his most honest work yet.

programme.title: Nobody's Gonna Do It For You: Ten Years of Sincere Engineer
programme.desc: Sincere Engineer reflects on ten years of wild journey, recognizing the village that helped raise it and thanking fans and friends.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jon Foreman, frontman of the GRAMMY-winning rock band Switchfoot, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation on surfing, faith, creativity, and the balance between joy and discomfort. They explore themes of mindfulness, artistic purpose, and growth through challenge — diving into Jon’s new solo album In Bloom and the philosophies that guide both his music and his life.

programme.title: Foxing: Live at The Grandel
programme.desc: Foxing performs Draw Down The Moon in full, captured live at The Grandel in St. Louis for a concert film experience.

programme.title: Billy Idol: State Line Live at the Hoover Dam
programme.desc: Punk icon Billy Idol makes history with the first-ever concert at the Hoover Dam, performing alongside longtime collaborator Steve Stevens and his band. This landmark event blends raw rock energy with stunning desert visuals and intimate acoustic moments. Featuring special guests Alison Mosshart (The Kills), Steve Jones (Sex Pistols), and Tony Kanal (No Doubt.

programme.title: Coldplay: Music of the Spheres Live at River Plate
programme.desc: Filmed during Coldplay’s record-breaking ten-night run at Buenos Aires’ River Plate Stadium, Music of the Spheres: Live at River Plate captures one of the most visually and sonically ambitious tours ever staged. With hits like “Higher Power,” “Viva La Vida,” “The Scientist,” and “Yellow,” the film showcases the band’s signature mix of immersive visuals, global unity, and emotional performance. Led by Chris Martin, Coldplay transforms the stadium into a kaleidoscopic celebration of love, connection, and hope, featuring surprise collaborations and multilingual crowd moments broadcast to fans worldwide.

programme.title: Poppy: Live at House of Blues in Anaheim
programme.desc: Poppy performs live at House of Blues Anaheim on the second leg of her “They’re All Around Us” Tour. This concert capture features dark, industrial-tinged themes and high-intensity vocals.

programme.title: Comedian CP: Sunday After Six
programme.desc: Known for his sharp wit and fearless storytelling, Comedian CP (Detroiters, Love Life, How to Die Alone) takes the stage in Sunday After Six — a no-holds-barred stand-up special that dives into fatherhood, relationships, race, and the kind of real-life moments you couldn’t make up. From awkward encounters to wild imagination, CP’s offbeat humor and unfiltered honesty make every punchline land harder than the last.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with comedian and host Jessi Cruickshank for a fast, funny conversation about boy-band fandom, parenting twins (and a third kid), and finding sanity on tour. They swap stories on public-parent life, the joys and chaos of twinhood, and how identity, confidence, and career evolve with family.

programme.title: Letlive: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Experience Letlive performing at The Wiltern in Los Angeles. Celebrate the music and the city that shaped it.

programme.title: Melissa Villaseñor: Welp... What Now?
programme.desc: In her debut stand-up special, SNL alum Melissa Villaseñor reflects on her six seasons at Saturday Night Live, life after fame, and finding herself through humor, music, and culture. Recorded live at the historic Bob Baker Marionette Theater in Highland Park, Los Angeles, with musical guests Wolves of Glendale.

programme.title: DEVO: 50 Years of De-Evolution…Live!
programme.desc: DEVO performs at Denver’s Mission Ballroom, blending art, technology, and attitude in a high-energy live show.

programme.title: Chase Atlantic: LOST IN HEAVEN
programme.desc: Chase Atlantic's LOST IN HEAVEN is a feature-length concert film capturing their final night at London’s O2 Arena.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Carmen Christopher: Live from the Windy City
programme.desc: Comedian Carmen Christopher returns home to Chicago for a sharp, surreal, and hilarious stand-up special that blends the absurd with the heartfelt. With quick wit and offbeat honesty, Christopher riffs on social media, family, dating, politics, and Midwest life in a performance that’s both painfully self-aware and laugh-out-loud ridiculous. Executive produced by Tim Robinson and Zach Kanin.

programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37; pianist Maya Oganyan makes her solo debut with the orchestra.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for Best Classical Solo Vocal Album "Crazy Girl Crazy" (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) in 2018 and took home the Grammy for Artist of the Year in 2022.

programme.title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.desc: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the development of music TV over the last 50 years and its power in popularizing the classical genre.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.

programme.title: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: In this August 2020 concert at the Lucerne Festival, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra; Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36.

programme.title: The Four Seasons

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! programme.desc: Lainie y Justin tienen un bebé de 9 meses juntos. Justin lastima a Lainie porque cree que ella es infiel. ¿Pero cómo reaccionará Steve cuando se enfrente a Justin?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: El 5 de agosto, la policía se llevó a la hija de 7 meses de Amber tras encontrarle quemaduras de cigarrillo por todo el cuerpo. La madre de Amber, Vickie, encontró las quemaduras y llamó a la policía, pero ¿quién la quemó?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Jessie ya está harta de los insultos, el acoso y las acusaciones de su novio Dakota, y quiere que pare antes de perder su trabajo. Larynee creía que su prometido Steven era el indicado, pero ahora no está tan segura y sospecha que la engaña.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Harta del maltrato en su relación, Carla le dice a su novio que es infiel con su compañero de cuarto. Luego, Jay quiere decirle a Nikki que ella se acostó con su amante Crystal.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: El novio de Priscilla la engaña y la culpa a ella y a su embarazo; Santana promete cambiar, pero quizá sea tarde; Scoota busca beneficios de pareja sin compromiso.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Alex se niega a perder a su exnovia sin luchar; CeeCee necesita revelar su verdadera identidad a la persona que le gusta en línea; Kyle y su hermana tienen secretos que confesar.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Las cosas iban muy bien con su nueva novia hasta que Roger se encontró en la cama con su amiga; el novio de Kandy revela un secreto que podría cambiar su generosidad; el novio de Dannisha continúa rogando por un trío.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Paige admite haberse acostado con el novio de su amiga; Alex confiesa haberla engañado con dos mujeres; Kaylynn decide vengarse de su amiga.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Brooklyn arroja luz sobre por qué una mujer casada contrajo una ETS; el marido de Brittany no es el único del que debería desconfiar; el novio de Brianna y su cómplice la han estado utilizando.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: La adicción de Juan Sebastián, abogado de 35 años, a las apuestas electrónicas lo llevó a perder casi todo y a un intento de suicidio.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Yiset Silva y Lisandro Rodríguez enfrentan un misterio tras el parto de su hija el 31 de diciembre de 2020 en Armenia. La clínica dice que la bebé nació sin vida, pero la familia cree que está viva. Inconsistencias en la historia clínica y una necropsia sin órganos aumentan sus dudas. La Fiscalía investiga.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: El miedo a las represalias ha impedido que las víctimas denuncien delitos en Colombia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Durante la pandemia, hubo cuerpos identificados incorrectamente, lo que dejó a muchas familias inseguras.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Un productor de Séptimo Día graba cómo en un bar en Bucaramanga se alquilan niños para mendicidad. Yiriam y Franklin, migrantes venezolanos, pierden a su hija menor tras dejarla al cuidado de Franyeli, quien es detenida por mendicidad ajena. La Policía y el ICBF intervienen en varios casos similares.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: La ira al volante se ha convertido en una patología cotidiana que afecta a miles de colombianos. Desde accidentes hasta homicidios, los desencadenantes de esta furia son múltiples, pero la empatía podrían prevenir tragedias en las vías.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, las muertes por accidentes viales por exceso de velocidad y embriaguez, siguen creciendo. A pesar de las tragedias, muchos conductores iresponsables quedan impunes, las leyes no logran frenar la creciente cifra de víctimas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Silene Acuña, embarazada, fue hallada muerta bajo el piso de su casa en Mosquera en abril de 2010. Su pareja, Luis Giovanni Mosquera, confesó el crimen tras huir y fue condenado a 21 años. Su hijo, testigo clave, reveló el asesinato en entrevista.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Luz Karime Parada, una joven y humilde campesina quien al parecer sostenía un romance con el hermano de su esposo. Un día, la joven en estado de embarazo desapareció y sólo un año después autoridades hallan el cuerpo enterrado en la casa de sus cuñados. Según declaraciones de familiares y conocidos la investigación apuntaba a un crimen netamente pasional.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2008, Nidia Yazmín González, madre soltera de 37 años, fue hallada muerta en el río Gámeza, Boyacá, con signos de brutal violencia. Mantenía una relación secreta con Alirio Castro, un hombre casado, posesivo y celoso. Pruebas clave —su cinturón negro en karate y un historial de maltrato— lo señalaron como responsable. Absuelto en 2009, la fiscalía apeló y en 2011 fue condenado a 33 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En una vereda de Cimitarra, Santander, Pedro Suta se obsesiona con Irene, esposa de su jefe Arcilio. Tras ser rechazado, la asesina junto a su hijo menor, decapitándola y desmembrando al niño. Ese día, Arcilio estaba de viaje con otro hijo por un tratamiento médico. Al descubrirse las desapariciones, la comunidad se alerta e inicia una intensa búsqueda para dar con el responsable del doble homicidio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Soacha, Doris Góngora y su hija de 8 años fueron halladas asesinadas en su vivienda. Evidencia de sangre, huellas y registros telefónicos llevaron a los investigadores hasta Jorge Antonio Trujillo, sobrino de Doris. A pesar de negar los cargos, las pruebas forenses lo vincularon directamente con el doble crimen. Fue condenado a 60 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y hurto calificado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El alemán Cristian se enamora de Yesmid en Armero Guayabal y forma una familia. Años después, ella planea su asesinato con sicarios, buscando quedarse con su fortuna.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Florencia, Caquetá, Lina, embarazada de siete meses, fue asesinada frente a su casa. Aunque el sicario escapó, un testigo señaló a Marmolejo, pareja de la víctima y padre de su bebé, como el autor intelectual del crimen. Pruebas contundentes, incluyendo el testimonio del propio pistolero, confirman que Marmolejo contrató el asesinato para deshacerse de Lina y estar con otra mujer.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Umar Al Hassan, refugiado liberiano de 50 años, deambula hace más de un año por las calles de Bogotá pidiendo ayuda. Tras huir de la guerra civil en Liberia y vivir en EE.UU. desde 1990, llegó a Colombia donde le robaron sus documentos. Indocumentado y sin hablar español, ha sido víctima de racismo, robos y golpizas. Mónica Chávez se unió a su causa, pero su historia sigue sin resolverse.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Fernando Araújo, exministro e ingeniero, fue secuestrado por las FARC en 2000 y mantenido cautivo durante 6 años en los Montes de María, soportando condiciones extremas. Escapó en 2006 tras un descuido de sus captores durante una operación militar. Perdió su matrimonio, pero recuperó su vida: dos meses después, el presidente Uribe lo nombró Ministro de Relaciones Exteriores.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Estas madres están desesperadas por encontrar a los padres desaparecidos de sus hijos. Pero estos padres que niegan que son los verdaderos padres y dicen que es imposible que lo sean. Cuando se descubran los resultados de ADN, ¿quién tendrá la razón y quién seguirá buscando respuestas?

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Brittany intenta probar hace 3 años que Dionte es el padre, pero él y su madre lo niegan. Luego, Camara y su amiga Nicole enfrentan a Chris por rechazar al bebé de Camara.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Una vez finalizada la fiesta Cristóbal y Ana llegan a su habitación para pasar su noche de bodas pero se encuentran a los niños durmiendo en la cama de matrimonial. Esto termina con los planes de Cristóbal de pasar una noche ideal. Por otra parte Ana festeja el hecho de postergar la noche de bodas. Sin embargo continúa pensando en Guillermo, trata de auto convencerse que ahora es una mujer casada y sólo debe pensar en Cris-to-bal. Guillermo por otra parte se mantiene firme en la decisión de estar separado de Yenny. Sin embargo Yenny monta toda una escena para convencer a Guillermo que cambió y volver a estar juntos.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Gisela a pesar de saber del engaño de Atanasio evita un enfrentamiento con su esposo hasta lograr obtener las pruebas que la ayuden a confirmar su infidelidad. Yubiri conversa con Solimar al informar a su amiga de su molestia al haber descubierto a Wilker en una mentira mas por causa de la irrupción de Yelitza en su noviazgo | Graciela comparte la conversación de Yubiri mostrándose dispersa al enfocar sus pensamientos en Atanasio tras su romántico encuentro en el hotel.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel se presenta en el barrio de Deibis para celebrar el carnaval. Presenta a Deibis y a Seis Nueve como los reyes del Hip Hop. Magdalena y Ana Belén siguen hablando de la fertilización que tuvieron que recurrir ambas. Efraín le pide a Valentina de mudarse junto a ella por unos días. Pero Valentina se niega rotundamente. Marilyn se encuentra a solas con Ricardo y quiere intentar seducirlo, pero él no para de hablar de Gabriel. Amelia va a ver a Merlín para que le hable de su hijo. Agustín va a ver a Magdalena y se muestra arrepentido de estar lejos de su esposa y su hijo, finalmente se lo lleva a la plaza. Deibis está muy contento por la oportunidad que le está dando su tío, Gabriel León.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela decide mudarse con Ricardo, quien bebe en exceso extrañando a Celia. Cecilia y Ricardo se besan, pero ella termina abofeteándolo. Margot expulsa a Alejandro y decide irse de Venezuela. Katiuska conspira con Renato para sacar a Manuela de la jugada. Marcelo busca reconciliarse con sus hijos mientras Graciela insiste en mudarse. El Dr. Carpio da noticias desalentadoras sobre Elizabeth, dejando la mudanza de Manuela en suspenso mientras Ricardo sigue atormentado por visiones.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo, al saber que Rosa no durmió en casa, cree la versión de Rosalía de que se fugó con Alejandro. Vilma entrega a Erasto el disquete con información crítica de la empresa de Adolfo, casi causándole un embargo. Rosa despierta en casa de Erasto y al ir al baño escucha a Erasto confirmar a Rivero que Alejandro está muerto; se desploma sobre él suplicando que sea mentira. Alejandro descubre que en el registro del Bramón faltan páginas. La empresa de alquiler informa a Rosalía que el carro apareció volcado vacío, y ella insiste en que es una burla.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Milagros pide hablar con Clemencia y Mayre le dice que no ha llegado, y en ese momento aparece Amada quien dice reconocer a Milagros. Mayre aclara que Amada tiene problemas con Clemencia y le aconseja a Milagros no involucrase en ellos. Vicky le anuncia a Enzo que está embarazada y Enzo sospecha de ella. Vick le dice que ese mismo día es la fiesta de su compromiso y conociendo su situación actual, debía ir. Enzo se dirige al laboratorio para verificar si realmente el examen es auténtico.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Humberto descubre en el cuarto de Eustoquio los documentos del Bramón y se los muestra a Isaías, quien corre a contarle a Blanca: son sus tierras. Amalia enfrenta a Rivero por las acusaciones contra Alejandro; Erasto llega y la galantea. Alejandro sorprende a Carlos declarándole a Rosa que se enamora de ella; los expulsa furioso. Andreína se casa con Robert tras llegar a la iglesia en camioneta. Eustoquio descubre a Consuelo y Blanca buscando los papeles en su apartamento. Erasto invade la recepción y exige a Natalia. Adolfo lo confronta amenazándolo con la policía.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto se lleva a Natalia de la fiesta y la golpea obligándola a arrodillarse. Le habla como si fuera Consuelo. Eustoquio confiesa a Isaías su infancia traumática jurando venganza contra todos. Robert y Andreína celebran sentando bases del matrimonio. Junior discute con Rosa porque ella se niega a dormir con él. Rosalía visita a Erasto y le revela los planes de Alejandro sobre las tierras. Eustoquio se niega a entregar los documentos a Blanca, prefiriendo extorsionar a Erasto. Rosa anuncia que irá a hablar con su madre Carmen Rosa para que se mude con ellos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo decide romper sociedad con Rosalía tras el atentado. Alejandro le pide a José Luis vigilar a Rosa. Carlos enfrenta a Rosalía haciéndole ver el daño que hace. Vilma se ala con Erasto contra Adolfo. Rosa va camino a la tienda de Consuelo pensando cómo enfrentarla, pero Eustoquio la engaña con falsos documentos y la lleva al monte para matarla. Junior empieza a perder la memoria preocupando a Marisela. Alejandro investiga en la Guajira cuando otro auto lo embiste sacando su carro de la carretera. Humberto chantajea a Erasto con copias de los documentos del Bramón.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Los malandros dan por muerto a Alejandro y vuelven a Caracas a cobrar. Alejandro sobrevive y es auxiliado por Severiano que cura su brazo con emplastos campesinos. Rosa convence a Eustoquio que el verdadero responsable de sus males es Erasto, no ella. Erasto engaña a Arminda prometiéndole su parte cuando aparezcan los papeles. Junior confiesa a Carlos que pierde la memoria. Consuelo se preocupa por la tardanza de Rosa. Rosa logra liberarse y toma un taxi a Caracas. Alejandro intuye que Rosalía lo traicionó al pensar quién sabía de su viaje. Rosa busca a Arminda exigiéndole la verdad sobre Eustoquio.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Tras un año de separación y sintiéndose alertada del regreso de Armando a Venezuela Finita visita su casa al buscar retomar su antiguo romance ahora avalada con el derecho de ser una mujer divorciada | Finita observa con horror la realización de su mas nefasta pesadilla al encontrarse con Natalia quien se presenta ante ella como la novia de Armando. en el local de persianas Botero se autocompadece de su situación como hombre y empleador tras haber perdido a Wilker como su empleado.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Tras una intensa interpretación de sus personajes en la trama de la película de Junior Graciela y Atanasio se reconcilian llevando así a la realidad sus sentimientos tras hacer pareja juntos en la filmación. programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
